summary: Morpheus recovers and rises from the chair, snapping his handcuffs as the Agents enter the adjoining room. Agent Smith sees Morpheus run past the open door, yells 'Nooo!', and fires a sweeping line of bullets across the sheetrocked wall. As Morpheus dives for the window, a bullet buries itself in his leg and knocks him off balance. Neo, believing 'He won't make it,' spins and snaps the other rope-end onto a bolted bar. Morpheus begins to fall, but Neo hurls himself into the open space; the two bodies collide, scramble, and briefly cling until the line snaps taut and cracks their embrace, sending Morpheus tumbling down. As Morpheus falls with the ground 'deliriously distant,' Neo snatches hold of his mentor's still handcuffed wrist and cries 'Gotcha!'

what_changes.before: Passive and downed, seated and handcuffed, apparently unable to act.
what_changes.after: Revived and moving — he rises, snaps his cuffs, and runs for the window, only to be shot in the leg and sent falling.
what_changes.evidence: Slowly, Morpheus lifts his face into the room's rain. When he finally opens his eyes, they are again dark and flashing with fire. He rises from the chair, snapping his handcuffs

what_changes.before: Mobile and nearly at the window, attempting escape.
what_changes.after: Wounded and falling, entirely dependent on Neo to keep from hitting the ground.
what_changes.evidence: a bullet buries itself in his leg, knocking him off balance. Morpheus tumbles, legs flipping over, falling down -- The ground deliriously distant as Neo snatches hold of his mentor's still handcuffed wrist.

what_changes.before: A bystander who doubts Morpheus can be saved: 'He won't make it.'
what_changes.after: He commits his own body to the rescue, seizing Morpheus's wrist mid-fall and taking charge of holding him.
what_changes.evidence: As Neo spins, every move a whip crack, snapping the other rope-end on to a bolted bar ... Neo snatches hold of his mentor's still handcuffed wrist. NEO Gotcha!

event_hint.one_line: Neo's mid-air rescue of a fleeing, wounded Morpheus from Agent Smith's gunfire.

uncertain: Whether the other two Agents (Jones, Brown) are present in the adjoining room at this moment; the scene only names Agent Smith.
Whether Neo and Morpheus successfully complete the rescue after 'Gotcha!', since the scene ends mid-fall.
The exact position of the other Agents relative to the open door.

minds.wants: To escape the building and survive — to reach the window and the extraction he himself arranged.
minds.feels: A resurgence of will and physical capability after being downed; the 'fire' is back. But this revival is immediately undercut by vulnerability — he is shot, thrown off balance, and then utterly at the mercy of physics and another person's grip.
minds.shows: Only action: rising, snapping the cuffs (a display of recovered strength), running, diving. He shows no fear, no appeal — and then, in the fall, nothing at all but a body being caught.
minds.basis: The scene's own change records: 'Passive and downed' to 'Revived and moving,' eyes 'dark and flashing with fire,' rising and snapping handcuffs. Then wounded, falling, 'entirely dependent on Neo.' His wrist is 'still handcuffed' — the cuffs didn't fully free him, a physical token of his partial, precarious recovery.

believes_about.belief: That Neo is now capable of saving him — that the man who was shouting 'Get up, Morpheus!' from the gunship has become someone who will throw his own body into the void to hold on.
believes_about.wrong_because: Morpheus cannot know, mid-fall, whether Neo's grip will hold or whether Neo has actually committed — his belief is pure trust, not knowledge, and the scene ends on the razor's edge before that trust is confirmed.

minds.wants: To stop Morpheus from escaping — to reclaim the prisoner who is running past his door.
minds.feels: Rage and a loss of composure uncharacteristic for him: the 'Nooo!' is a crack in the agent's cold control, the sweeping fire an act of fury rather than precision. He has just been gunned down by Neo (sc-166) and is reconstituted; the prisoner slipping away compounds the humiliation.
minds.shows: A single失控 cry and a violent, indiscriminate sweep of bullets across the wall — letting the anger show in a way Jones and Brown, in this same building, do not.
minds.basis: His 'Nooo!' and the sweeping line of fire rather than an aimed shot; sc-166 establishes he was just killed by Neo and has returned. The sweep is emotional, not tactical — he fires at where Morpheus ran, shredding sheetrock.

believes_about.belief: That Morpheus is contained property — a captive who cannot simply get up and walk out — so his escape is an outrage to be prevented.
believes_about.wrong_because: The handcuffs snapping and Morpheus running prove the prisoner is already beyond Smith's control; Smith is reacting to a loss that has already happened.

minds.wants: To keep Morpheus from dying — to convert his own body into the anchor that stops the fall.
minds.feels: A shift from despairing certainty ('He won't make it' — resignation, the same helpless watcher who could only will Morpheus to rise in sc-166) into decisive, self-risking action. The rescue is not calm competence but 'furious desperation,' and it nearly fails — the line cracks their embrace and Morpheus still falls.
minds.shows: First the spoken doubt, then whip-crack motion: snapping the rope to the bar and hurling himself into space. He shows commitment, not confidence — the final 'Gotcha!' is a straining grasp, not a secured victory.
minds.basis: His line 'He won't make it' (a bystander's judgment) immediately precedes his physical commitment; sc-166 shows him attaching the rope to his own harness and begging Morpheus to move. Here he completes that arc by making himself the tether.

believes_about.belief: At the instant of 'He won't make it,' that Morpheus cannot be saved — the mentor is beyond reach.
believes_about.wrong_because: He reverses this belief within seconds by acting; the judgment was despair, not fact, and his own body disproves it.

connects_back: sc-166: Neo gunning down the Agents and attaching the climbing rope to his own harness — this scene is the payoff of that setup.
sc-166: Neo's helpless 'Get up, Morpheus! Get up!' — his will-to-action here replaces his earlier inability to rouse his mentor.
The handcuffs from Morpheus's capture in the executive office: his 'still handcuffed wrist' is the lingering residue of his captivity.
Agent Smith's death and reconstitution in sc-166, which fuels the fury behind his 'Nooo!' and indiscriminate fire.
sets_up: ev-030: The trio's arrival at the subway — Morpheus must survive this fall to reach the phone-booth exit.
ev-030/ev-031: Neo's growing willingness to put his body between danger and his people, foreshadowing his solo stand against Smith.
The deepening of Neo and Morpheus's bond — the mentor saved by the student — which undergirds Morpheus's later faith in Neo (ev-032).
dramatic_function: It converts Neo from a doubting observer into an active savior by forcing him to stake his own body on the person he thought lost, while giving Morpheus a hard-won, precarious survival that keeps the escape alive without resolving it — the scene trades certainty for a grip on a falling wrist.
